pages.text: Your farm can feed a village. Place a $(item)Supply Terminal$() in one, or find one in a $(l:drone_systems/tech_village)Drone Mechanist's Outpost$(/l), and the village starts asking you for food and materials, and paying for them.

An unemployed villager takes the terminal as his job site, like a farmer takes a composter, and becomes a $(l)Drone Mechanist$(): a villager in goggles and a white work coat. While he works it, the terminal shows his level and the village's contracts.
pages.title: The Drone Mechanist

pages.text: $(l)Right-click$() him to talk: he has a plan for a $(l:drone_systems/tech_village)tech village$(/l). His trades are behind the $(l)Trade$() button at the end of each talk.

The board holds $(l)three contracts$(); every two minutes the mechanist fills the free places. Each asks for a quantity of one item: bread, carrots, wool and wheat at first; leather, logs, pumpkins and beef as the mechanist levels up; then iron, glass and fish; and from the expert level on,
pages.title: Contracts

pages.text: aluminum, circuits and carbon fiber. The higher his level, the bigger the contracts and the better they pay, and no two are quite the same size.

Put the goods in the $(l)Deliver$() slot: by hand, with a hopper, or as the destination of a $(l:drone_systems/modules)Transport drone$(/l)'s route. The terminal only takes what is still wanted, so a drone brings exactly what the contracts need and nothing more.
Some contracts pay a $(l)bonus$() besides their emeralds, shown on the row: battery cells, circuits, addons, carbon fiber, even an Anchor Addon or an Elite Circuit from a master mechanist.

The fourth place on the board is for the village's events:$(br)$(li)$(l)Market Day$(): every morning the village holds a market, a contract $(l)three times$() the usual size and pay, always with a bonus. It closes at dusk: fill it in time.
pages.title: Events

pages.text: $(li)$(l)Call to arms$(): while a $(l)raid$() is on the village asks for iron, arrows or shields. Fill it and $(l)two iron golems$() join the fight.

Every filled contract makes the village more $(l)prosperous$(): its emeralds count as points. Once you have founded the $(l:drone_systems/tech_village)tech village$(/l) with the Mechanist, the bar under the board shows its level and how far the next one is; the $(l)Range$() switch beside it outlines the village's bounds in the world. When the bar is
pages.title: Prosperity

pages.text: full and the last level's buildings stand, $(l)talk to the Mechanist$() to raise the village a level: it grows, a baby villager or an iron golem arriving, rings its bell, and makes you its hero: $(l)Hero of the Village$() for twenty minutes, stronger at each level, with big discounts and gifts from the villagers. At the top level, $(l)10$(),

A filled contract:$(br)$(li)pays $(l)emeralds$(), and any bonus, into the $(l)Pay$() slot (take them by hand, or with a hopper or a drone);$(br)$(li)gives the mechanist $(l)experience$(): he levels up, from Novice to Master, unlocking bigger contracts and new trades;
pages.title: Rewards

pages.text: $(li)makes the village $(l)like you$(): every villager around gives you better prices, the mechanist most of all. The goodwill goes to whoever founded the village (before that, to whoever placed the terminal).

The Drone Mechanist sells CyberFarm parts for emeralds, more as he levels up:$(br)$(li)$(l)Novice$(): Basic Circuits; buys redstone$(br)$(li)$(l)Apprentice$(): Battery Cells; buys copper$(br)$(li)$(l)Journeyman$(): Advanced Circuits, Aluminum Ingots
pages.title: The mechanist's trades

pages.text: $(li)$(l)Expert$(): Speed and Stack Addons, Carbon Fiber$(br)$(li)$(l)Master$(): Elite Circuits, the Anchor Addon
